stories.title: Brilliant Things to Eat and Drink This December
stories.summary: From promising new pubs and sumptuous Christmas feasts to an 18-course New Year’s Eve supper club, we’ve rounded up the best spots for a month of festive merriment

stories.title: Big Girls Don’t Cry Will Make You Rethink Your Adolescence
stories.summary: Paloma Schneideman opens up on her Jane Campion-produced first feature, a surprising coming-of-age story about a teenage girl grappling with shame and desire in mid-2000s New Zealand

stories.title: Eight Jewellers to Have On Your Radar
stories.summary: At a new showcase presented by the Sarabande Foundation, eight fine jewellers find beauty in unlikely places – from extinct flowers and ancient artifacts to mushrooms in the Slovakian countryside

stories.title: Rose Wylie On Ridley Scott’s Napoleon
stories.summary: Now 91, the artist thinks about the French protagonist, Ridley Scott’s portrayal of him and how she draws on the material she encounters in everyday life and the media

stories.title: Cartier Legends from Louis XIV to Elizabeth Taylor
stories.summary: “The design is at the service of the stones,” says Pierre Rainero, the house’s director of image, style and heritage on some of the house's most famous creations

stories.title: From the YBAs to the Suffolk Marshes: Johnnie Shand Kydd’s New Perspective
stories.summary: Best known for his portraits of the YBAs in their hedonistic heyday, Johnnie Shand Kydd is now telling his own story via a stark landscape imbued with family history

stories.title: Nan Goldin’s Brutal, Beautiful Worlds
stories.summary: The artist’s new show at London’s Hayward Gallery stretches from her own battle with opioid addiction to the innocence of a vanishing ecosystem

stories.title: AnOther Performance: Lewis Gribben
stories.summary: About to break out with his role in the new Blade Runner, the Glasgow-born actor tells us why he admires Eminem’s performance in 8 Mile

stories.title: Louise Giovanelli: Shimmering and Cinematic
stories.summary: As her third exhibition opens at White Cube Mason’s Yard, the painter tells us about her painting rituals, recurring subject matter and unsettling new directions

stories.title: AnOther Loves: A Party Purse
stories.summary: Matthieu Blazy reworks Chanel’s classic handbag – iridescent and bejewelled, and just in time for party season

stories.title: Damien Jalet in Conversation With PJ Harvey
stories.summary: Musician PJ Harvey and choreographer Damien Jalet find common ground in an intimate conversation about creativity, performance and the fear of starting something new

stories.title: This Lush Black Comedy and Sundance Winner Takes Aim at Manila’s Elite
stories.summary: Director Rafael Manuel on his first feature, Filipiñana, a quietly seething class satire about a tee-girl’s tumultuous day at a golf resort in Manila

stories.title: What the Canadian National Anthem Taught Jerskin Fendrix About Music
stories.summary: The experimental musician and Yorgos Lanthimos collaborator considers the peculiar possibilities of the album format, creative freedom and the virtues of getting sick of yourself

stories.title: A Guide to the Absurdist Comedy of Nathan Fielder
stories.summary: As his documentary on disgraced Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes hits UK cinemas, we delve into Nathan Fielder’s back catalogue, from Finding Frances to The Curse

stories.title: Mahershala Ali on Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
stories.summary: “It’s like he’s having a violent conversation with God,” says the Oscar-winning Moonlight star of his role in Bassam Tariq’s new film, a stylish hitman thriller that doubles as a surprising study in shattered faith

stories.title: AnOther Dish: Gabriel Waterhouse and Patricia Wakaimba’s Oysters
stories.summary: The couple behind east London’s modern British restaurant, Waterhouse, share a hot and tart recipe for dressing creamy Lindisfarne oysters

stories.title: Haruki Murakami’s Legendary 70s Tokyo Jazz Club Comes to London
stories.summary: From 1974 to 1981, and before global literary fame, Haruki Murakami ran a scrappy jazz club in Tokyo’s Sendagaya neighbourhood, resurrected this month at the Barbican

stories.title: John Divola’s New Monograph Celebrates a Storybook Romance
stories.summary: The Californian photographer’s latest photo book, Sheila, brings together rarely seen portraits of his beloved then-wife with some of his most career-defining works

stories.title: You Can See Everything: A Reckoning for the Post-Truth Age
stories.summary: Explosively funny and haunting in equal measure, Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s doc on disgraced Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes has resonance far beyond its central story
